name: What does plumbing coordination involve in a construction project?

mainEntity.name: What does plumbing coordination involve in a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing coordination involves planning and managing the installation of all plumbing systems within a construction project. This includes working with architects, other contractors, and suppliers to ensure that pipes, fixtures, and drainage are installed correctly, on schedule, and in compliance with local codes. Effective coordination prevents conflicts with other building components and ensures efficient water supply and waste removal.
